sub_graphs.title: Constantinople Block Validation Process
sub_graphs.description: Models the comprehensive block header and body validation for Constantinople fork

nodes.label: Block Received
nodes.description: A new block has been received from the network for validation

nodes.label: Validate Block Number
nodes.description: Verify block number exceeds zero and follows parent sequentially

nodes.label: Validate Timestamp
nodes.description: Verify timestamp strictly exceeds parent timestamp

nodes.label: Validate Gas Limit
nodes.description: Verify gas limit within bounds: parent ± (parent / 1024), minimum 5000

nodes.label: Validate Gas Used
nodes.description: Verify gas used does not exceed gas limit

nodes.label: Validate Extra Data
nodes.description: Verify extra data field does not exceed 32 bytes

nodes.label: Validate Parent Hash
nodes.description: Verify parent hash matches keccak256 of encoded parent header

nodes.label: Validate Difficulty
nodes.description: Verify difficulty matches calculated value based on parent and timestamps

nodes.label: Header Validated
nodes.description: All header validation checks have passed

nodes.label: Header Invalid
nodes.description: One or more header validation checks failed

sub_graphs.title: Constantinople Proof-of-Work Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the Ethash proof-of-work verification process

nodes.label: Header Pending PoW Check
nodes.description: Header has passed basic validation, awaiting PoW verification

nodes.label: Generate Header Hash for PoW
nodes.description: Generate header hash excluding nonce and mix_digest fields

nodes.label: Generate Ethash Cache
nodes.description: Generate or retrieve Ethash cache based on block number epoch

nodes.label: Execute Hashimoto Light
nodes.description: Compute hashimoto_light using header hash, nonce, and cache

nodes.label: Verify Mix Digest
nodes.description: Compare computed mix_digest with header's claimed mix_digest

nodes.label: Verify Difficulty Target
nodes.description: Verify result is below difficulty threshold

nodes.label: Proof-of-Work Valid
nodes.description: Block satisfies Ethash proof-of-work requirements

nodes.label: Proof-of-Work Invalid
nodes.description: Block fails proof-of-work verification

sub_graphs.title: Constantinople Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the transaction execution flow including gas refunds

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction has been received for processing within a block

nodes.label: Validate Intrinsic Gas
nodes.description: Verify transaction provides sufficient gas for intrinsic cost

nodes.label: Recover Sender Address
nodes.description: Extract sender address from transaction signature

nodes.label: Check Sender Nonce
nodes.description: Verify transaction nonce matches sender account nonce

nodes.label: Check Sender Balance
nodes.description: Verify sender has sufficient balance for gas fees and value transfer

nodes.label: Deduct Gas Fee
nodes.description: Subtract maximum gas cost from sender balance

nodes.label: Execute Message Call
nodes.description: Execute transaction in isolated EVM environment

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Refund
nodes.description: Compute refundable gas: max 50% of consumed gas or refund counter

nodes.label: Refund Sender
nodes.description: Return unused gas value to sender

nodes.label: Pay Miner Fee
nodes.description: Transfer transaction fee to coinbase address

nodes.label: Cleanup Marked Accounts
nodes.description: Delete accounts marked for self-destruct during execution

nodes.label: Transaction Processed
nodes.description: Transaction execution complete with receipt generated

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External account or contract submitting transaction

sub_graphs.title: Constantinople Difficulty Adjustment
sub_graphs.description: Models the difficulty calculation including 5M block bomb delay

nodes.label: Parent Block Known
nodes.description: Parent block data available for difficulty calculation

nodes.label: Calculate Time Delta
nodes.description: Compute timestamp difference between current and parent block

nodes.label: Calculate Difficulty Offset
nodes.description: Compute offset: (parent_difficulty / 2048) * max(1 - (delta / 10), -99)

nodes.label: Calculate Difficulty Bomb
nodes.description: Compute bomb: 2^((block_number - 5,000,000) / 100,000 - 2) for blocks > 5M

nodes.label: Sum Difficulty Components
nodes.description: Add parent_difficulty + offset + bomb_component

nodes.label: Enforce Minimum Difficulty
nodes.description: Ensure difficulty is at least MINIMUM_DIFFICULTY (131072)

nodes.label: Difficulty Calculated
nodes.description: New block difficulty has been computed

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly enumerate which EIPs are included in Constantinople
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Constantinople includes EIP-145 (bitwise shifting), EIP-1014 (CREATE2), EIP-1052 (EXTCODEHASH), EIP-1283 (SSTORE metering). This needs cross-reference with EIP meta.

ambiguities.text: The ommer adjustment multiplier of 1 or 2 is mentioned without clear conditions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume multiplier is 2 if ommers are present in the block, 1 otherwise. This affects difficulty adjustment timing.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Ethash cache generation is assumed to be deterministic and reproducible across all nodes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-deterministic cache would cause different PoW validation results, breaking consensus

implicit_assumptions.description: The 50% gas refund cap prevents abuse of SSTORE refund mechanism
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unlimited refunds could enable economic attacks or unexpected gas dynamics

implicit_assumptions.description: The 5,000,000 block difficulty bomb delay constant is correctly applied at Constantinople activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect bomb delay would cause unexpected difficulty spikes or drops

implicit_assumptions.description: All 255 recent block hashes are available for BLOCKHASH opcode
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing historical hashes could break contracts relying on BLOCKHASH for randomness
